reports.title: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: National statistical office of Pakistan, responsible for compiling and disseminating national accounts, price indices, censuses and other official macroeconomic and socio-demographic statistics.

reports.title: National Accounts of Pakistan (2015-16 base)
reports.description: Annual national accounts estimates of GDP, GNI, gross fixed capital formation and related aggregates for Pakistan, compiled at current and constant prices with base year 2015-16.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) Pakistan (2015-16 base)
reports.description: Monthly national, urban and rural Consumer Price Index series for Pakistan, with base year 2015-16, classifying items using a COICOP-based item structure.

reports.title: Pakistan's Balance of Payments
reports.description: Annual balance of payments and external-sector statistics for Pakistan compiled and published by the State Bank of Pakistan.

reports.title: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics
reports.publisher: Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
reports.description: National statistical office of Bangladesh, responsible for compiling national accounts, price statistics, censuses and other official socio-economic data.

reports.title: National Accounts Statistics of Bangladesh (2015-16 base)
reports.description: GDP and related national accounts aggregates for Bangladesh, compiled by production and expenditure approaches with base year 2015-16 following a 2022-23 rebasing exercise.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) of Bangladesh (2021-22 base)
reports.description: Monthly national, urban and rural Consumer Price Index series for Bangladesh, rebased to 2021-22 and organised into 12 major expenditure categories.

reports.title: Department of Census and Statistics
reports.description: The central government agency responsible for producing Sri Lanka's official statistics, including national accounts, censuses, price indices and other socio-economic data.

reports.title: National Accounts Estimates of Sri Lanka (2015 base)
reports.description: GDP and related macroeconomic aggregates for Sri Lanka compiled by the Department of Census and Statistics, with the latest rebasing to 2015.

reports.title: Colombo Consumer Price Index (CCPI) and National Consumer Price Index (NCPI)
reports.description: Monthly consumer price indices for Sri Lanka: the CCPI covering urban Colombo and the NCPI covering the country nationally, each organised into 12 major expenditure groups.

reports.title: Balance of Payments Statistics of Sri Lanka
reports.description: Balance of payments and external-sector statistics for Sri Lanka compiled by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, published on a BPM6 basis from 2012 onward.

reports.title: National Statistics Office (Nepal)
reports.description: Nepal's central statistical agency, renamed from the Central Bureau of Statistics, responsible for national accounts, censuses and official statistics.

reports.title: National Accounts Statistics of Nepal
reports.description: Annual and quarterly GDP and related national accounts aggregates for Nepal compiled by production and expenditure approaches, with base year 2010/11 after the most recent rebasing.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Nepal
reports.description: Monthly national and regional Consumer Price Index for Nepal, compiled by the central bank using an updated basket and weights, following COICOP 2018 and the CPI Manual: Concepts and Methods (2020).

reports.title: National Statistics Bureau
reports.description: National statistical office of Bhutan, responsible for national accounts, CPI, surveys and other official statistics.

reports.title: National Accounts Statistics of Bhutan
reports.description: Quarterly and annual GDP and related macroeconomic aggregates for Bhutan, published by the National Statistics Bureau (e.g. its Third Quarter GDP Report).

reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Bhutan
reports.description: Monthly national and regional Consumer Price Index series for Bhutan, published by the National Statistics Bureau.

reports.title: Maldives Bureau of Statistics
reports.description: National statistical office of the Maldives (established under the Maldives Statistics Act 2021 as successor to the former National Bureau of Statistics), responsible for national accounts, CPI, censuses and other official statistics.

reports.title: National Accounts of Maldives (2014 base)
reports.description: GDP estimates (production and expenditure approaches) for the Maldives compiled under SNA 2008 with base year 2014.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index of Maldives
reports.description: Monthly Consumer Price Index series for the Maldives, classified according to COICOP 2018 (in use since the 2016 CPI update), with weights from household income and expenditure surveys.

reports.title: Balance of Payments Statistics of Maldives
reports.description: Balance of payments and external-sector statistics for the Maldives compiled by the Maldives Monetary Authority.

dependencies.basis: PBS's own national-accounts FAQ page directly answers which SNA edition governs Pakistan's GDP compilation (verified live, not just Grok's quote).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Which version of SNA is used to compile GDP in Pakistan? 2008

dependencies.basis: IMF's own press release announces Pakistan's implementation of the e-GDDS and its National Summary Data Page, which covers national accounts dissemination; independently corroborated by Pakistan's 2003 GDDS-subscription press release and by the /e-gdds/ (not /sdds/) URL structure DSBB uses for Pakistan.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Pakistan Implements the International Monetary Fund's Enhanced General Data Dissemination System (IMF Press Release No. 19/03, January 15, 2019)

dependencies.basis: BBS's own 'Fifty Years of National Accounts Statistics of Bangladesh' publication states the current methodology follows the 2008 SNA.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The methodology presented below is based on the concepts, definitions, and classifications recommended in the 2008 SNA.

dependencies.basis: DCS's own national accounts page states current estimates follow SNA 2008.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Currently DCS follows the guidelines of system of National Accounts 2008 (SNA – 2008), which includes the latest set of boundaries, methodologies, concepts and recommendations.

dependencies.basis: IMF DSBB's 2024 SDDS Annual Observance Report for Sri Lanka, which covers the national accounts category, confirms Sri Lanka's SDDS subscription is current.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sri Lanka subscribed to the SDDS on November 3, 2015, and met all the SDDS requirements at the time of subscription.

dependencies.basis: CBSL's own external-sector statistics page labels its balance-of-payments series as compiled on a BPM6 basis from 2012 onward.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Balance of Payments (BPM6 Basis) - Annual (2012 to Latest)

_dropped.why: [EDITION-AMBIGUOUS] PBS's own CPI methodology PDF (base 2015-16) names 'Classification of Individual Consumption on Purpose (COICOP)' but never states an edition/year (not 1999, not 2018). Verified live at https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/methodology_of_price_statistics_base_year_2015-16.pdf. Grok proposed the 1999 edition based on no more evidence than we found; per the edition-matching rule we will not guess. Needs a document that names the edition to resolve.

[DEAD-URL / CONFLICTING] Grok's cited URL (sbp.org.pk/publications/bop/BOPFY24/Intro.pdf) now 404s/redirects to SBP's generic publications listing, which shows Pakistan's BOP report has moved to Excel-archive-only distribution with no visible methodology note. SBP's site confirms the report itself is real (Annual, FY24) so we mint the node, but we could not find a live document naming BPM6. The IMF DSBB metadata API (getBaseSummaryofMethodologies, countryCode=PAK, categoryCode=BOP00) actually states the opposite — 'The framework of Pakistan's balance of payments follows the guidelines and recommendations of BPM5' with BPM6 described as 'under consideration' — but this DSBB snapshot also looks stale (compare Bhutan/Bangladesh cases below) so we don't trust it as current either. Net: can't currently verify either way.

[NOT-FOUND] Could not find an IMF press release or working DSBB page confirming Bangladesh's e-GDDS/NSDP implementation the way we could for Pakistan/Nepal/Bhutan/Maldives. Grok's cited DSBB URL (dsbb.imf.org/e-gdds/country/BGD/summary-of-dissemination) is a JS shell with no retrievable content, and the DSBB API for BGD/NAG00 returned what appears to be stale legacy metadata (citing '1993 SNA' and a base year of 1995-96, contradicted by BBS's own current 2015-16-base, SNA-2008 documents), so we don't trust it as evidence of current dissemination-tier status either.

[EDITION-AMBIGUOUS] BBS's own live CPI (base 2021-22) methodology document states items are classified into '12 major categories' using COICOP but never names an edition/year. Verified at https://objectstorage.ap-dcc-gazipur-1.oraclecloud15.com/n/axvjbnqprylg/b/V2Ministry/o/office-bbs/2024/12/f886ed6c67b0411783a01c4039e6b141.pdf (BBS's own object storage, linked from bbs.gov.bd). The DSBB API for BGD/CPI00 separately returned an apparently stale description citing 'eight commodity groups', further evidence DSBB metadata for Bangladesh cannot be trusted as current. Not enough to pick an edition.

[MISMATCHED-SOURCE / EDITION-AMBIGUOUS] Grok's cited evidence_url (statistics.gov.lk/Resource/refference/SriLankaNSSReviewReport) turned out on live fetch to mention COICOP only in a National Accounts classification-systems list, not in connection with the CPI at all — a mismatched citation. We separately checked DCS's own NCPI February 2022 release directly, which describes '12 main groups' in the CPI basket but never names COICOP or an edition anywhere in the document. Can't mint without a document that ties COICOP (with an edition) specifically to the CCPI/NCPI.

[SITE-UNREACHABLE / CONFLICTING] nsb.gov.bt's document subpaths (including Grok's cited NAS-2024-for-WEB.pdf and every other nsb.gov.bt/publications or /wp-content path we tried) consistently failed to fetch with SSL/robots errors, even though the site's root page loads fine — the National Statistics Bureau's own PDFs are effectively unreadable to us right now. As a check we queried the IMF DSBB metadata API (countryCode=BTN, categoryCode=NAG00), which actually states Bhutan's national accounts 'broadly follow the United Nations System of National Accounts 1968' — directly conflicting with Grok's claimed SNA-2008 quote, and looking itself like stale/legacy GDDS metadata never updated. We could not adjudicate between these with a live, readable source, so we drop the edge rather than guess. bt-national-accounts as a report node is still minted — the Q3 2025 GDP report's existence is independently confirmed on the NSB homepage.

[SITE-UNREACHABLE] Same nsb.gov.bt access problem as bt-national-accounts — Grok's cited CPI_July-report.pdf and every alternative NSB publication path we tried failed to fetch. The DSBB API for BTN/CPI00 loaded but only described '363 items... aggregated into 12 major groups' with no mention of COICOP or an edition at all, so it doesn't corroborate Grok's 1999-edition claim either. bt-cpi as a report node is still minted — the November 2025 CPI release's existence is independently confirmed on the NSB homepage.

[CONTRADICTED] Grok claimed BPM6 (citing an MMA 'shift from BPM5'), but the IMF DSBB metadata API (countryCode=MDV, categoryCode=BOP00) — the same class of source Grok cited — currently and explicitly states: 'The balance of payments statistics are compiled broadly following the guidelines recommended in the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual, fifth edition (BPM5).' No BPM6 language appears anywhere in that document. mma.gov.mv's own statistics pages are robots-disallowed to us so we could not independently adjudicate further; on the evidence we could reach, BPM5 (not BPM6) is what's actually stated. mv-mma-bop as a report node is still minted since MMA's compilation of BOP/external-sector statistics itself is corroborated by this same DSBB page and by the 'External Sector' category on mma.gov.mv's homepage.

[NAME-CHANGE] Grok proposed 'mv-nbs' / 'National Bureau of Statistics (Maldives)'. The live statisticsmaldives.gov.mv site now identifies itself as the 'Maldives Bureau of Statistics' (MBS), and a Presidency of Maldives press release (20 July 2021, on the Maldives Statistics Act, Act No. 16/2021) confirms the agency's resources, staff and obligations were transferred from the former National Bureau of Statistics to the new, independent Maldives Bureau of Statistics, headed by a Chief Statistician. We minted the institution as 'mv-mbs' / 'Maldives Bureau of Statistics' to match current reality rather than Grok's proposed id/name.

_dropped.edge: pk-national-accounts / pk-cpi — SDDS vs e-GDDS tier correction (note, not a drop)
_dropped.why: [PROMPT-ASSUMPTION-CORRECTED] The research brief suggested checking Pakistan's 'current tier' as an SDDS subscriber, but we found no live evidence of Pakistan being on SDDS today. IMF's 2003 press release (imf.org/external/np/sec/pr/2003/pr03198.htm) shows Pakistan joined the (predecessor) GDDS, not SDDS; DSBB's own site structure files Pakistan under /egdds/ and /e-gdds/ paths, not /sdds/; and IMF Press Release 19/03 (2019) shows Pakistan implementing the upgraded e-GDDS. We minted pk-national-accounts -> imf-e-gdds accordingly and did not mint any Pakistan -> imf-sdds edge.
